findings.evidence: The validation commands render deck.md without registering a custom theme, although the lint branch explicitly supports a registered custom theme and references/theme-css-guide.md requires --theme-set name.css.
findings.fix: For custom-theme decks, register the theme CSS in both HTML and PNG validation commands, and preserve the documented argument ordering so the input is not consumed by --theme-set.
